name: Songseeker Wilds
desc:
Songseeker Wilds is a set of islands located in [the Aratel Sea](location:the_aratel_sea). It is home to [Ancient Rotlands](location:ancient_rotlands), provides a passage to [Minityrsa](location:minityrsa), and is south-east of [Summer Isle](location:summer_isle).

It consists of 2 land masses, a smaller and larger one, separated by the ocean.
additional_info:
-   The music for this area is The Sun, Gleaming by Naktigonis
-   The combat music for this area is Thrill Of The Hunt by Naktigonis
